facts.fact: In Universal Ads' vendor-commissioned 'Beyond the Scroll' study, viewers are 43% more likely to look at a streaming TV ad than a social ad.
facts.quote: +43% more likely to look at a streaming TV ad

facts.fact: In Universal Ads' 'Beyond the Scroll' study, viewers spend 67% more time watching TV ads than social media ads.
facts.quote: They spend **+67% more time watching TV****ads** compared to social media ads.

facts.fact: In Universal Ads' 'Beyond the Scroll' study, emerging brands get 2.9x higher visual attention to streaming TV ads than well-known brands.
facts.quote: with **2.9x higher visual attention** as compared to their more “well-known brand” counterparts.

facts.fact: In Universal Ads' 'Beyond the Scroll' study, viewers who see both a streaming TV ad and a social ad show 2.8x higher unaided recall.
facts.quote: There is **2.8x higher unaided recall** when viewers see both a streaming TV and social ad.

facts.fact: In Universal Ads' 'Beyond the Scroll' study, a TV ad paired with a social video feed ad (such as Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts) produces 5x higher recall.
facts.quote: Viewers experience**5x higher recall** when a TV ad is paired with an ad via social video feed

facts.fact: In Universal Ads' 'Beyond the Scroll' study, emerging brands see a 2.3x higher brand perception lift from TV than well-known brands.
facts.quote: emerging brands seeing a **2.3x higher lift** than well-known brands.

facts.fact: In Universal Ads' 'Beyond the Scroll' study, adding a streaming TV ad to a social campaign increases purchase intent by 24%, while two social ads alone show no significant lift.
facts.quote: leads to a **+24% increase in purchase intent** – whereas two social ads alone show no significant lift.

facts.fact: Viewers exposed to both streaming TV and social media ads are 2.8x more likely to remember the brand, according to Universal Ads.
facts.quote: Viewers exposed to both streaming TV and social media ads are **2.8x more likely to remember the brand**.

facts.fact: Viewers exposed to both streaming TV and social media ads are 2.1x more likely to visit the brand's website, according to Universal Ads.
facts.quote: They’re also **2.1x more likely to visit the brand’s website** to learn more.

facts.fact: Universal Ads' 'Beyond the Scroll' study was conducted in partnership with MediaScience.
facts.quote: Study conducted in partnership with MediaScience.
